summary: Proceed with no companions. One run gives a readable answer: the timed path is master's c63801e7, mode 0 is checked against master's launch, and the deadlines leave about 50 s of slack before the build cutoff. Three things to fix before building: mode 2's add-based sink inflates t2; mode 4 drops the epilogue, so t1 + t2 - t4 counts the epilogue twice; and OVERLAPPED does not justify refuting the K-pair TLP claim.
justification: A. The mechanism question is well posed and matches master's code (consume_item, submission.py:2747: dq_stage, then 8 wgmma, commit, wgmma_wait<0>, release; serial inside each warpgroup). KS is right: w13 64, w2 32. Mode 0 against master's launch at 0.97-1.03x, plus the attrs/spill check, is a proper in-run control. The prior is accurate. PREPARE BUDGET is realistic: LO-skipped master ended w2st at 149.7 s (7db6fa1a) and 155.4 s (b2941ea); fsilu builds took 32-33 s; anat timing about 15-20 s, ending around 200-235 s, under the 255 s step deadline and 300 s. WEAKEST LINKS: (1) g = (t0 - max(t1,t2))/t0 does NOT bound TLP levers: t1 is the MMA path as master schedules it (wgmma_wait<0> per stage + full-barrier wait), not the tensor-core floor; LESSONS:180 shows a ~9-10% TLP gain with this same serial structure. Print each GEMM's wgmma math floor next to t1 and t4; refute K-pair only if t1 is also within ~10% of max(math floor, t4). (2) Mode 2's sink folds 32 a0 registers into acc with real adds, which can add 10-25% to t2; use asm volatile("" :: "r"(a0[r][k])) per register instead. (3) Mode 4 skips the epilogue while t1 and t2 keep it, so t1 + t2 - t4 double-counts the epilogue; keep mode 3's zero-pack epilogue (with stores) in mode 4, or add mode 5 = producer + zero epilogue and use t5 in the serial formula; keep t4 as the pure ingest floor. (4) The runtime MODE branch near wgmma may make ptxas serialize the wgmma pipeline (C7510/C7512, CLAIMS:68); branch on MODE once per item outside the k-loop, grep the build log for C7510/C7512 and print it on the attrs line. Smaller: mode 1's constant A should not be all zeros; print the per-class N-bucket histogram with the STAGE line; the decision's 2.5% sum should use the all-row rega share (~40%), not sliding-only (48-53%).
